name: Award of Cash Incentive to the Toppers at Regional Level and Students Scoring Centum in the Subjects Involving Theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools in the Union Territory of Puducherry
benefit:
- For students securing top three ranks at the regional level in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools: 1st Rank: ₹20,000/-; 2nd Rank: ₹15,000/-; 3rd Rank: ₹10,000/-.
- For students scoring centum in the subjects involving theory in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Higher Secondary Course Examin
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a citizen of India. - The applicant must be a resident of the Union territory of Puducherry, by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years. - The applicant must be a student appearing in Secondary School Leaving Certificate/Secondary School Certificate/Intermediate/Higher Secondary Public Examinations in Government Schools. - The applicant must have passed the qualifying examination in the first attempt. - The applicant's marks from consecutive attempts must not be taken into account.
